- Thu, Feb 19 3:00–3:40 PM PT
- Fri, Feb 20 10:00–10:40 AM PT

On another note, if there was an internal incident or you need to push for a different week, that’s fine — just let us know and we’ll rebook accordingly.

Proposed slots (all 40 minutes):
- Fri, Feb 20 10:00–10:40 AM PT (preferred by SE for NVidia cluster availability)
- Fri, Feb 20 2:00–2:40 PM PT
- Mon, Feb 23 9:00–9:40 AM PT

Agenda (30–40 min):
1) 10 min — Brief intro + production use cases relevant to ArchivalAI
2) 15–20 min — Live demo: throughput/latency profiling, prefix caching scenario, and fallback routing
3) 10 min — Integration Q&A: VPC peering, KMS, data retention, and observability
4) 5 min — Next steps: POC sizing and timeline

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (one-slide summary) and demo-agenda.md (detailed bullets).

Pre-demo ask (helps us prioritize):
- Which integration is highest priority (S3 ingestion, real-time logs, or batch embeddings)?
- Any compliance constraints (SOC2, data residency) we should prep for?
